gold_sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-71.070095 42.36737)',4326) AS pt
),
nearby_tiles AS (
  SELECT d.rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, origin o
  WHERE d.rast && ST_Expand(o.pt, 1.0)
),
masked AS (
	  SELECT ST_MapAlgebra(
	           rast,
	           1,
	           '32BF'::text,
	           'CASE WHEN [rast.val] < 480 THEN [rast.val] ELSE NULL END'::text,
	           NULL::double precision
	         ) AS rast
  FROM nearby_tiles
),
qualifying_pixels AS (
  SELECT (pp).geom AS geom
  FROM masked
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_PixelAsCentroids(rast, 1, TRUE) AS pp
)
SELECT MIN(ST_Distance(p.geom::geography, o.pt::geography)) AS distance_m
FROM qualifying_pixels p, origin o;

WITH point_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-71.070095, 42.36737), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
dem_subset AS (
  SELECT
    rast
  FROM
    public.dem_us
  WHERE
    ST_Intersects(
      rast,
      ST_Envelope(ST_Transform(point_geom.geom, 3857))
    )
),
nearest_low_elevation AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(ST_Distance(point_geom.geom, ST_PointN(ST_ExteriorRing(ST_Buffer(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(x, y), 4326), 0.0001)), 1))) AS distance
  FROM
    dem_subset,
    LATERAL ST_DumpAsPolygons(rast, 1) AS dump(x, y, val)
  WHERE
    val < 480
)
SELECT
  distance
FROM
  nearest_low_elevation;
